SF-REQ-013.title: Requirements → BIU compilation
SF-REQ-013.text: Lower governed requirements into bounded BIUs with explicit requirement-satisfaction links and dependency DAGs.

SF-REQ-015.title: BIU lint/readiness
SF-REQ-015.text: Check BIUs for unresolved decisions, incomplete boundaries, missing acceptance/verification obligations, architecture constraints, and dependency problems. Agent-Ready remains execution-readiness authority.

identity_allocation_evidence.verified_by: grep for PY-\\d / PY-[0-9] / \\d\\d[A-Z] across src, tools, tests, test, scripts
identity_allocation_evidence.consequence: No identifier grammar exists anywhere in repository code or authority. The grammar this design states will be the first.
identity_allocation_evidence.width_inconsistency: PG/PY use two digits; WO-000013 uses six. Any grammar must either cover both or say which is canonical.
identity_allocation_evidence.coordinator_note: The PY-\\d\\d parser defect the coordinator experienced was in bootstrap tooling outside this repository. Phase 3 correctly ruled it UNSUPPORTED as a promotion candidate on durable evidence. It is recorded here as context for the grammar decision, not as an in-repository incident.
